title: First‑run Station: compact guided mini‑tour + snapshot checklist
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a compact, modular 'station' mini‑tour that sits on the Console home empty state. The component is a horizontal snapshot card with progressive tips, checklist toggles, and optional animated micro‑widget screenshots. This ticket covers visual assets, annotated screenshots for engineering, copy variants, and an interactive motion spec for the tour entrance and checklist reveal.
acceptance_criteria: Design handoff contains full artboard set for light/dark themes (SVG and PNG slices)
Micro‑motion spec (0.6s entrance, 0.18s stagger) documented in a single ProtoPie file link
Three copy variants for tips (Concise / Guided / Exploratory) reviewed by PM
Annotated engineering spec with spacing tokens, accessible color contrasts, and aria hints
Assets validated in a smoke build: card renders on empty state, checklist toggles persist locally
notes: 2025-02-14 — Kickoff: synced with PM (Rita Alvarez) to align scope; agreed to produce 3 copy variants and two screenshot variants.
2025-02-18 — Design review: adjusted CTA prominence and reduced card width to 560px for responsive fit; UX flagged persistent checklist state as critical for power users.
2025-02-22 — Engineering feedback: requested explicit token names for spacing and color; provided initial exported SVGs with named layers.
2025-02-26 — Accessibility pass: confirmed contrast ratio 4.5:1 for primary text in light/dark; added aria-expanded hints to checklist button.
2025-03-01 — PM review: selected 'Guided' copy as default; asked to ship motion spec v1 and placeholder assets for the next QA cycle.
